notes: Compatible patch release carrying the accepted issue #333 enrollment-policy enforcement slice for public email signup and invitation redemption. Both public mutation routes enforce the same provider-backed policy published by the additive auth-v2 response, preserve existing login and frozen /api/v1 behavior, retain the exact non-boolean integer schema-v1 gate and deployed environment fallback, and map unknown schema-v1 modes to existing safe denial envelopes before mutation. Operational enrollment-decision logging uses reviewed bounded values and must succeed before account or invitation mutation; it is not immutable provider-backed actor/change audit, which remains deferred to issue #528. The release adds no Admin write, readiness policy, RBAC, UI, OAuth/provider enablement, provider network, public exposure, credential, DNS, billing, mail, or issue-closure change. It retains the MySQL schema-two/schema-three rollback bridge with apply_policy held, production at exact schema two, and exact immutable v0.9.5.40 as the application-only predecessor; database rollback is prohibited. Schema-three activation, the MySQL composite transaction, receipt-table grant and drift hardening, routes, games, Slots adoption, ledger behavior, provider scaling, and all-provider atomicity remain separately governed. Issues #333, #430, and #471 remain open.
